## LISA

LISA: local indicators of spatial association

+----------------------+------------------------------------+--------------------------+
|                      | Neighbors underpredicted           | Neighbors overpredicted  |
+======================+====================================+==========================+
| **High Spatial Lag** | 1 AM \> Mean                       | 1 AM \> mean             |
|                      |                                    |                          |
|                      | Neighbors \> mean                  | Neighbors \< mean        |
|                      |                                    |                          |
|                      | Underpredict -\> missing something |                          |
+----------------------+------------------------------------+--------------------------+
| **Low Spatial Lag**  | 1 AM \< mean                       | Pocket of overprediction |
|                      |                                    |                          |
|                      | Neighbors \> mean                  |                          |
+----------------------+------------------------------------+--------------------------+
